translations.original: "Open a new conversation in a new tab"
"How can I do better? We would love to hear your feedback!"
translations.chinese: "我可以如何做得更好？我們非常樂意聽取你的意見回饋！"
"Claude 在本次對話階段的表現如何？"

translations.original: "Thank you very much for the feedback!"

translations.chinese: "無法傳送意見回饋：沒有作用中的對話階段"
"技能、子代理、外掛程式與 MCP 伺服器"

translations.original: "Toggle fast mode for faster responses (Opus only)"
translations.chinese: "開啟快速模式以獲得更快的回應（僅限 Opus）"
"選取程式碼並要求進行編輯"
"給 Claude 需要記住的規則"
"讓 Claude 不間斷地持續編輯"
"針對複雜的變更使用規劃模式"

translations.original: "Hold Shift while dragging to drop files into Claude Code"
translations.chinese: "拖曳時按住 Shift，即可將檔案放入 Claude Code"

translations.original: "Click or drag to set effort level"
translations.chinese: "點擊或拖曳以設定思考投入度等級"
"點擊以循環切換思考投入度等級"

translations.original: "Claude will automatically choose the best permission mode for each task"
translations.chinese: "Claude 會自動為每項工作選擇最合適的權限模式"

translations.original: "Claude will not ask for approval before running potentially dangerous commands"
translations.chinese: "Claude 在執行具有潛在危險的命令前，將不會請求你的核准"

translations.original: "In Ask before editing mode, Claude will never change files without approval."
translations.chinese: "在「編輯前詢問」模式下，Claude 絕不會在未經核准的情況下變更檔案。"
"% 的剩餘上下文空間，用盡後將自動壓縮 (auto-compact)。"

translations.original: "Conversation was compacted to free up context."
translations.chinese: "已壓縮對話以釋放上下文空間。"

translations.original: "If the redirect page shows a connection error, paste the URL from your browser's address bar:"
translations.chinese: "若重新導向頁面顯示連線錯誤，請從瀏覽器的網址列複製並貼上該 URL："

translations.original: "View and control this session from claude.ai/code"
translations.chinese: "從 claude.ai/code 檢視並控制此對話階段"
"為所有對話階段啟用遠端控制"

translations.original: "Connect new sessions to claude.ai/code automatically so you can view and control them from the web."
translations.chinese: "自動將新對話階段連線至 claude.ai/code，讓你可從網頁檢視並控制它們。"

translations.original: "Usage tracking is only available for Claude AI subscribers."
translations.chinese: "用量追蹤僅提供給 Claude AI 訂閱者使用。"

translations.original: "No attribution data yet · accumulates as you use Claude"
translations.chinese: "尚無歸因資料 · 隨著你使用 Claude 會逐漸累積"
"Fable 5 現在改用用量點數 (usage credits)"

translations.original: "Fable 5 requires usage credits, which aren't enabled for your account — switched to your default model for this session"
translations.chinese: "Fable 5 需要用量點數 (usage credits)，但你的帳戶尚未啟用 — 本次對話階段已切換為你的預設模型"

translations.original: "Switched to your default model — Fable 5 requires usage credits"
translations.chinese: "已切換為你的預設模型 — Fable 5 需要用量點數 (usage credits)"

translations.original: "Switched to your default model for this session — Fable 5 requires usage credits"
translations.chinese: "本次對話階段已切換為你的預設模型 — Fable 5 需要用量點數 (usage credits)"

translations.original: "Switched to your default model, now your saved default — Fable 5 requires usage credits"
translations.chinese: "已切換為你的預設模型，並設為你儲存的預設值 — Fable 5 需要用量點數 (usage credits)"
"建立 git 工作樹 (worktree) 失敗："

translations.original: "Failed to rewind: no checkpoint for this message"
translations.chinese: "回溯失敗：此訊息沒有檢查點 (checkpoint)"
聚焦或取消聚焦 Claude 視窗

translations.original: Tired of repeating yourself? Tell Claude to remember what you’ve told it using CLAUDE.md.
translations.chinese: 厭倦了重複輸入指令嗎？透過 CLAUDE.md 記錄已知資訊，讓 Claude 擁有持久記憶。
"來寫出值得部署上線的程式吧。"

translations.original: "Type /model to pick the right tool for the job."
translations.chinese: "輸入 /model 為目前的工作選擇適合的工具。"

translations.original: "Use planning mode to talk through big changes before a commit. Press"
translations.chinese: "在提交 commit 前，使用規劃模式詳細討論重大變更。按下"

translations.original: "Make a CLAUDE.md file for instructions Claude will read every single time."
translations.chinese: "建立一個 CLAUDE.md 檔案，用來存放 Claude 每次都會讀取的說明指示。"

translations.original: "You’ve come to the absolutely right place!"

translations.chinese: "開啟 Claude Code 擴充功能設定"

translations.original: "Open a new Claude instance in the Terminal"
translations.chinese: "在終端機中開啟新的 Claude 執行實例"
"拖曳至此處以作為上下文引用"
"是否前往終端機管理外掛程式？"

translations.original: "After installing plugins, reload this extension to use them here."
translations.chinese: "外掛程式安裝完成後，請重新載入此擴充功能以便在此處使用。"

translations.original: "Continue in Terminal to change output style?"
translations.chinese: "是否前往終端機更改輸出樣式？"

translations.original: "After changing your output style in Terminal and reloading this extension, you'll be able to use it here."
translations.chinese: "在終端機修改輸出樣式並重新載入擴充功能後，即可在此處生效。"

translations.original: "Once agents are configured in Terminal, you can reload this extension and ask Claude to use them here."
translations.chinese: "在終端機設定完成後，重新載入此擴充功能即可在此處呼叫 Agent。"

translations.original: "Once hooks are configured in this repository, they'll be active in your IDE, too."
translations.chinese: "在此儲存庫設定 Hooks 後，它們也會在你的 IDE 中生效。"
"是否前往終端機編輯記憶內容？"

translations.original: "Once configured, memories will be picked up by Claude Code here in your IDE."
translations.chinese: "設定完成後，Claude Code 將會在你的 IDE 中同步這些記憶內容。"

translations.original: "Permission settings are shared between Terminal and this IDE."
translations.chinese: "權限設定會在終端機與 IDE 之間共享。"
"目前沒有執行中的 MCP 伺服器。"

translations.original: "Report model issues to the research team"
"No marketplaces configured. Add one above to discover plugins."
translations.chinese: "尚未設定市集。請在上方加入一個市集以探索外掛程式。"

translations.original: "Use Claude Code in the terminal to configure MCP servers. They’ll work here, too!"
translations.chinese: "在終端機中使用 Claude Code 設定 MCP 伺服器，設定也同樣會在此處生效！"

translations.original: Claude is requesting permission to use
translations.chinese: Claude 正在請求使用權限

translations.original: "Claude will edit your selected text or the whole file. Click, or press Shift+Tab, to switch modes."
translations.chinese: "Claude 將編輯你選取的文字或整個檔案。點擊或按 Shift+Tab 可切換模式。"

translations.original: "Claude will explore the code and present a plan before editing. Click, or press Shift+Tab, to switch modes."
translations.chinese: "Claude 將先探索程式碼並在編輯前提供方案。點擊或按 Shift+Tab 可切換模式。"

translations.original: "Claude Code will not ask for your approval before running potentially dangerous commands."
translations.chinese: "Claude Code 在執行具有潛在危險的命令前，將不再請求你的核准。"

translations.original: "Claude will ask before each edit. Click, or press Shift+Tab, to switch modes."
translations.chinese: "Claude 將在每次編輯前進行詢問。點擊或按 Shift+Tab 可切換模式。"

translations.original: Not showing Claude your current file selection
translations.chinese: 不向 Claude 顯示目前選取的檔案

translations.original: Showing Claude your current file selection
translations.chinese: 正在向 Claude 顯示目前選取的檔案
"查看帳戶資訊與使用量限制"
"是否在終端機中繼續管理 MCP？"

translations.original: " command-line tool to configure system-wide or private servers."
translations.chinese: " 命令列工具，來設定系統級或私有伺服器。"

translations.original: "Once configured, MCPs will be reflected in your IDE, too."
translations.chinese: "設定完成後，MCP 也會在你的 IDE 中生效。"

translations.original: "Claude Code can be used with your Claude subscription or billed based on API usage through your Console account."
translations.chinese: "Claude Code 可以連結你的 Claude 訂閱使用，也可以透過 Console 帳戶按 API 使用量計費。"

translations.original: "How do you want to log in?"
"Use your Claude Pro, Team, or Enterprise subscription"
translations.chinese: "使用你的 Claude Pro、Team 或 Enterprise 訂閱"

translations.original: "Pay for API usage through your Console account"
translations.chinese: "透過你的 Console 帳戶按 API 使用量付費"

translations.original: "Instructions on how to use API keys or third-party providers."
translations.chinese: "關於如何使用 API 金鑰或第三方提供商的說明。"
"更傾向於終端機的操作體驗嗎？"

translations.original: "No plugins available. Add a marketplace to discover plugins."
translations.chinese: "沒有可用的外掛程式。請加入市集以發現更多外掛程式。"

translations.original: "Disable plugin (stays installed but will not load)"
translations.chinese: "停用外掛程式（維持安裝但不會載入）"
"啟用外掛程式（下次重新啟動後載入）"

translations.original: "Make sure you trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it. Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files, or other software are included in plugins and cannot verify that they will work as intended or that they won't change."
translations.chinese: "在安裝、更新或使用外掛程式之前，請確保你信任該外掛。Anthropic 並不控制外掛程式中所包含的 MCP 伺服器、檔案或其他軟體，且無法驗證它們是否能如預期運作，或保證其內容不會更動。"

translations.original: "Only for you, only in this repo"
translations.chinese: "僅限於你，且僅在目前儲存庫中"
"重新啟動 Claude 以套用外掛程式變更"

translations.original: "A new forked conversation will be created after rewinding."
translations.chinese: "回溯後將會建立一個新的分支對話。"

translations.original: "Rewinding does not affect files edited manually or via bash."
translations.chinese: "回溯不會影響手動編輯或透過 bash 編輯的檔案。"

translations.original: "Failed to rewind code: No file checkpoint found"
translations.chinese: "回溯程式碼失敗：找不到檔案檢查點 (Checkpoint)"

translations.original: Code rewind completed, but \$\{([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\} \$\{\1===1\?"file was":"files were"\} skipped:
translations.chinese: 程式碼回溯已完成，但有 ${$1} 個檔案被略過：

translations.original: "Failed to fork conversation: Unknown session id"
translations.chinese: "分支對話失敗：未知的對話階段 (Session) ID"

translations.original: "\u201D requires adding a new marketplace source: "
translations.chinese: "\u201D 需要加入新的市集來源："

translations.original: "What to do first? Ask about this codebase or we can start writing code."
translations.chinese: "接下來要做什麼？你可以先詢問關於此程式碼庫的問題，或者我們可以直接開始編寫程式碼。"
"是的，允許本次對話階段中的所有編輯"
"是的，允許 ",$1," 和另外 ",$2," 個項目的權限，用於 ",$3
"是的，允許存取 ",$1," 個目錄，用於 ",$2
"儲存至 .claude/settings.local.json（已加入 git 忽略）"
"改為告訴 Claude 該做什麼"

translations.original: "Toggle fast mode for faster responses (Opus 4.6 only)"
translations.chinese: "開啟快速模式以獲得更快的回應 (僅限 Opus 4.6)"

translations.original: "Claude will ask for approval before making each edit"
translations.chinese: "Claude 在進行每項編輯前都會要求手動審核"

translations.original: . Click to change, or press Shift+Tab to cycle.
translations.chinese: 。點擊以修改，或按 Shift+Tab 輪流切換。

translations.original: "Claude will edit your selected text or the whole file"
translations.chinese: "Claude 將編輯你選取的文字或整個檔案"

translations.original: "Claude will explore the code and present a plan before editing"
translations.chinese: "Claude 將先探索程式碼並在編輯前提供方案"

translations.original: "Add files or folders to the conversation"
translations.chinese: "向對話中加入檔案或資料夾"
"設定模型的思考投入程度等級"

translations.original: "Click a position to set effort level"
translations.chinese: "點擊位置以設定思考投入度等級"

translations.original: "Upload a file to include in conversation"
translations.chinese: "上傳檔案並將其加入目前對話中"
"透過 @ 提及來引用專案檔案"

translations.original: "Restore code and conversation to an earlier point"
translations.chinese: "將程式碼與對話恢復至先前的時間點"
"設定 MCP (模型上下文協定) 伺服器"

translations.original: "Review the plan above and decide whether to proceed"
translations.chinese: "請審核上方計劃並決定是否繼續"

translations.original: "Switch models when a message is flagged"
"When safety measures flag a message, automatically switch to a different model to keep chatting. When off, your session will pause instead."
translations.chinese: "當安全機制標記某則訊息時，自動切換至其他模型以繼續對話；關閉時，則會改為暫停你的對話階段。"

translations.original: "When safeguards flag a message, automatically switch to a different model to keep chatting. When off, your session will pause instead."
translations.chinese: "當安全防護機制標記某則訊息時，自動切換至其他模型以繼續對話；關閉時，則會改為暫停你的對話階段。"

translations.original: "This model's safeguards flagged this message. This sometimes happens with safe, normal conversations."
translations.chinese: "此模型的安全防護機制標記了這則訊息。這偶爾也會發生在安全、正常的對話中。"

translations.original: `\$\{([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\}'s safeguards flagged this message\. This sometimes happens with safe, normal conversations\.`
translations.chinese: `${$1} 的安全防護機制標記了這則訊息。這偶爾也會發生在安全、正常的對話中。`

translations.original: `\$\{([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\}'s safeguards flagged this message\. Our intentionally broad safeguards allow us to deliver more capabilities faster, but can sometimes flag legitimate coding, cybersecurity, and biology tasks\.`
translations.chinese: `${$1} 的安全防護機制標記了這則訊息。我們刻意把防護範圍設得較廣，好讓我們更快帶來更多功能，但有時也會誤標正當的程式開發、資訊安全與生物學工作。`

translations.original: `\$\{([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\}'s safeguards flagged this message\. The safeguards are intentionally broad right now and may flag safe and routine coding, cybersecurity, or biology work\. These measures let us bring you Mythos-level capabilities sooner, and we're working to refine them\.`
translations.chinese: `${$1} 的安全防護機制標記了這則訊息。目前防護範圍刻意設得較廣，可能會誤標安全而例行的程式開發、資訊安全或生物學工作。這些措施讓我們能更早為你帶來 Mythos 等級的能力，我們也仍在持續調校。`

translations.original: You can continue with a different model.
translations.chinese: 你可以改用其他模型繼續對話。

translations.original: "Switch to the default model and continue"
"After making changes, exit Claude in Terminal, and reload the IDE extension to use them here."
translations.chinese: "變更完成後，請在終端機中結束 Claude，並重新載入 IDE 擴充功能，即可在此處使用。"

translations.original: "All sessions share one limit. If you don't need them all at once, queueing uses it more evenly."
translations.chinese: "所有對話階段共用同一個用量上限。若你不需要同時使用，改用排隊方式能讓用量分配得更平均。"

translations.original: "Approximate, based on local sessions on this machine — does not include other devices or claude.ai"
translations.chinese: "此為概估值，依據本機上的本機對話階段計算 — 不含其他裝置或 claude.ai。"

translations.original: "Claude may use instructions, code, or files from this skill."
translations.chinese: "Claude 可能會使用此技能中的指示、程式碼或檔案。"
"要使用用量點數繼續在 Fable 5 上運作嗎？"

translations.original: "Each subagent runs its own requests. Be deliberate about spawning them — and consider configuring a cheaper model for simpler subagents."
translations.chinese: "每個子代理都會執行各自的請求。請審慎決定是否建立子代理 — 較單純的子代理可考慮改用較便宜的模型。"

translations.original: "Fable 5 runs on usage credits, billed separately from your plan. You don't have usage credits yet."
translations.chinese: "Fable 5 以用量點數運作，與你的方案分開計費。你目前尚無用量點數。"

translations.original: "Fable 5 was included in your plan for a limited time, and now requires usage credits."
translations.chinese: "Fable 5 先前在限定期間內包含於你的方案中，現在則需要用量點數。"

translations.original: "Heavy skills can be scoped down or run with a cheaper model via skill frontmatter."
translations.chinese: "較龐大的技能可透過 skill frontmatter 縮小適用範圍，或改用較便宜的模型執行。"

translations.original: "If the browser didn't open, visit this URL:"
translations.chinese: "若瀏覽器未自動開啟，請前往此 URL："

translations.original: "If this runs frequently, consider configuring its subagents with a cheaper model or tightening their prompts."
translations.chinese: "若此項會頻繁執行，可考慮為其子代理設定較便宜的模型，或精簡它們的提示詞。"
"了解我們如何運用你的意見回饋"

translations.original: "Longer sessions are more expensive even when cached. /compact mid-task, /clear when switching to new tasks."
translations.chinese: "對話階段越長，即使有快取也越昂貴。工作進行到一半可用 /compact，切換到新工作時則用 /clear。"

translations.original: "MCP tool results stay in context for the rest of the session. /compact to flush them, or disable servers you don't need."
translations.chinese: "MCP 工具的結果會在本次對話階段的後續過程中持續佔用上下文。可用 /compact 清除它們，或停用你不需要的伺服器。"

translations.original: "Our newest model for complex, long-running work. Switch anytime with /model."
translations.chinese: "我們最新的模型，專為複雜、長時間執行的工作而設計。隨時可用 /model 切換。"

translations.original: "Output style is set via /config. After changing it in Terminal and reloading this extension, you'll be able to use it here."
translations.chinese: "輸出樣式透過 /config 設定。在終端機中變更並重新載入此擴充功能後，即可在此處使用。"

translations.original: "Review what this plugin contributes — its agents, skills, and MCP tools all count toward your limit."
translations.chinese: "請檢視此外掛程式提供了哪些項目 — 其代理、技能與 MCP 工具都會計入你的用量上限。"

translations.original: "Select a message to restore code and fork the conversation from that point."
translations.chinese: "選擇一則訊息，即可還原程式碼並從該處分支出新的對話。"

translations.original: "These are often background/loop sessions. Continuous usage can add up quickly so make sure it is intentional."
translations.chinese: "這些通常是背景／循環執行的對話階段。持續使用可能會快速累積用量，請確認這是你刻意執行的。"

translations.original: "This session was started on a different branch. Switch to continue with the original context."
translations.chinese: "此對話階段是在另一個分支上啟動的。請切換分支以沿用原本的內容脈絡。"

translations.original: "User chose to stay in plan mode and continue planning"
translations.chinese: "使用者選擇維持在規劃模式並繼續規劃"
"是什麼正在消耗你的用量上限？"

translations.original: "Claude will approve actions that pass a safety check and pause for anything risky"
translations.chinese: "Claude 會核准通過安全檢查的操作，遇到有風險的操作則暫停。"

translations.chinese: % 的用量是在 >150k 上下文下產生的

translations.chinese: % 的用量來自大量使用子代理的對話階段

translations.original: % of your usage was while 4+ sessions ran in parallel
translations.chinese: % 的用量發生在 4+ 個對話階段並行執行時

translations.original: % of your usage came from sessions active for 8+ hours
translations.chinese: % 的用量來自持續活躍 8+ 小時的對話階段

translations.original: these are independent characteristics of your usage, not a breakdown
translations.chinese: 這些是你用量的獨立特徵，而非逐項拆解
麥克風存取遭拒 — 請前往
